lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs, creating a coordinate-like grid where primary high-intensity spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible across the flank, exhibiting sharp luminance transitions from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel from the branchial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of high-luminance blobs; approximately 8 to 10 distinct circular pixel clusters are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the dermis: one posterior to the mouth, one on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, and others on the mid-lateral flank. A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, less structured punctate spots compared to the organized grid pattern of the primary lateral flank.
